filename: 传承关羽-六星封侯-龙魂真身-重制候选.png
must: The NEW dragon-bodied Guan Yu is sacred and recognizably red-faced and black-bearded, not an ordinary standing human. prompt:
Use case: compositing, identity-and-layout-preserving card production.
Create ONE complete SIX-STAR collectible Guan Yu card. Flat orthographic front, portrait 2:3, complete visible physical card outline, not a poster and not a photographed tabletop. Reference image 1 is the NEW SIX-STAR LIFE-FORM CHARACTER ART and is the hero to use. Reference image 2 is the TRUE APPROVED FIVE-STAR CARD LAYOUT. Recreate its established layout and thin iridescent DIAMOND/CRYSTAL blue-white-silver frame, and insert the new art from image 1 in place of its mech illustration. This is a conservative UI restoration with a genuinely evolved hero. The card should immediately look like a member of the same card set as image 2. No new 06 thick emerald-gold rectangular frame, no new horizontal star row, no giant new name slab, no active ability bar or icon. Never include the mech figure from image 2.
PRESERVE LAYOUT ANCHORS OF IMAGE 2: upper-left round faction medallion; top-center name within narrow top frame; upper-right large diamond LV badge; RIGHT SIDE VERTICAL STAR RAIL; right-lower THREE compact passive labels vertically stacked; lower-left circular advancement location; lower-right small circular spearhead troop icon; same full thin white-blue faceted frame and four complete corners. All UI inside connected card silhouette; substantial central picture window. Exterior beyond silhouette transparent or clean dark neutral, not drawn scene; interior remains fully opaque illustrated art.
ONLY authorized layout changes from the five-star reference:
- Exactly SIX clearly separated five-point crystal stars vertically down right rail, not five and not seven. SIX means 6 total.
- Replace old “天” inside lower-left circular rank location with an integrated small solid crimson-jade and gold 3D imperial marquis SEAL that clearly reads “封侯”, keeping the original circular frame location and nearby cloud curls. The seal is IN THE CARD at LOWER LEFT, never floating in the sky and not a giant object covering the hero.
- Replace hero name and 3 passive labels with the form-specific exact text below.
No active-skill icon, active-skill text, active bar or “被动技能” heading; the approved five-star design has only three compact passive bars and these must stay that way. No new faction/level explanatory labels. Faction text exactly “蜀”. Level badge text exactly “LV” over “1”, not “IV”. Bottom-right troop icon is the same spearhead icon, no added text plaque.
Strong beautiful holy Tyndall light beams descend FROM ABOVE inside the artwork and strike the hero AND the lower-left 封侯 seal, making a coherent supernatural investiture connection. The in-card seal summons the overhead light, not vice versa; keep its letters readable. The light is not a replacement for the new evolved body. Match existing illustration scene lighting, deepen defined rays through mist and particles. Do not overexpose the face, white hair, skill text or frame.
CRITICAL: preserve new anatomy, pose, face and design of image 1 faithfully while shrinking/reframing it enough that the main evolved silhouette is visible through the full art window. Never revert to the five-star body or add mechanical armor. No new extraneous effects, no anatomy changes, no duplicate limbs, no text within art. All typography accurate simplified Chinese, compact, high contrast light text with narrow dark outline similar to the established frame. No other numbers, no invented stats, no watermark.
NAME: “传承·关羽”. Three passive labels from top to bottom, verbatim: “龙骧 +1”, “震夏 +1”, “武圣 +1”.
ART INVARIANTS: The NEW dragon-bodied Guan Yu is sacred and recognizably red-faced and black-bearded, not an ordinary standing human. Preserve his entire connected coiling serpentine lower body and green guandao, which are the most important evidence of life-form evolution; do not crop away the lower coil or replace it with humanoid legs.
